# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5153

# Review — PAN-5153
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — the sidebar can hide every project with no way to expand them when a stored "Other" collapse meets a one-owner project list (FR-10)

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5153-review-8d1ca5fa
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5153/.pan/review/agent-pan-5153-review-8d1ca5fa/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5153 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5153
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5159
- HEAD reviewed: 8d1ca5faa6070e13dd6c9ab0c0fea251565f73af
- Base: merge-base 09bf7ff0dcd601a9d66d916848dfd782ba7003b9 (origin/main); no prior review cycle
- Spec: .pan/drafts/pan-5153.md (FR-1..FR-14, NFR-1..NFR-5, W1..W13, AC 1..13). The manifest's acceptanceCriteria list was empty, so the PRD's "Acceptance criteria" section was used.

## Blocking Findings
### [correctness] A stored "Other" collapse hides the whole single-group project list, and no header is left to expand it — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx:698`
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect; in_pr_scope (FR-10: "With fewer than two owners the list renders as it does today").
- Trigger and changed-code connection: with two or more owners and some projects without `github_repo`, the operator collapses the "Other" group. `toggleOwner(null)` stores `OTHER_OWNER_KEY` (`''`) under `overdeck.sidebar.collapsedOwners`. Later the list drops to fewer than two owners, for example when a project is removed or a `github_repo` changes. Then `groupProjectsByOwner` returns one group with `owner: null`. `Sidebar.tsx` still computes `groupCollapsed = collapsedOwners.includes(group.owner ?? OTHER_OWNER_KEY)`, which is true, and renders `(groupCollapsed ? [] : group.projects)`. The header renders only when `ownerGroups.length > 1`, so it is absent.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected the full project list as before the change. Observed: the sidebar project list is empty. There is no owner header to click and no "No projects" text, because `projects.length > 0`. The state lives in localStorage, so it survives reloads. The only recovery is clearing site storage by hand.
- Evidence: a scratch probe at `/home/eltmon/.overdeck/tmp/claude-1000/-home-eltmon-Projects-overdeck-workspaces-feature-pan-5153/5a2d2454-cbad-4c8d-844c-84ba7522dd31/scratchpad/probe/probe.mts` runs the real `groupProjectsByOwner` plus Sidebar's render rule with the stored set `[""]`. With owners acme+eltmon+Other the result is `["<header acme>","a","<header eltmon>","b","<header Other>"]`. With owners acme+Other, the result is `[null] -> []`, an empty list. `Sidebar.ownerGroups.test.tsx` does not cover a stored collapse with one group. Limitation: this is a logic probe, not a browser render. The render rule was read directly from `Sidebar.tsx` lines 697–703.
- Fix: apply collapse state only when headers render, for example `const groupCollapsed = ownerGroups.length > 1 && collapsedOwners.includes(group.owner ?? OTHER_OWNER_KEY);`. Add a Sidebar test: one owner, localStorage `overdeck.sidebar.collapsedOwners = [""]`, and every project still renders.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [requirements] Contracts package touched despite the "no contracts change" non-goal — `packages/contracts/src/telemetry.ts:252`
- Severity: ? MAY
- Classification / scope: specification defect (in_pr_scope)
- Trigger: the new frontend fetch of `/api/github/identities` needs telemetry route/area allowlist entries (`/api/github/identities`, `github`). The diff adds both to `TELEMETRY_CLIENT_ROUTES` / `TELEMETRY_CLIENT_ROUTE_AREAS` and regenerates `docs/TELEMETRY.md`.
- Expected / observed / impact: Non-goal 10 says "a contracts package change" is out of scope, and Decision 10 restricts this to the response type. The change is two allowlist strings, not a response-type contract, and the telemetry list is what a new client route requires. No runtime impact.
- Evidence: `src/dashboard/server/__tests__/route-scopes.test.ts:74` ("lists every scoped path as a telemetry client route (PAN-5100)") requires every `ROUTE_SCOPES` path in `TELEMETRY_PROPERTY_DOMAINS.client_route`. W7 step 3 requires the scope row, so the spec itself forces this contracts edit.
- Fix: none needed in code. The spec's non-goal should read "no contracts type for the endpoint response" so the enforced telemetry allowlist entry is not read as a violation.

### [requirements] "Run pan doctor to re-check" does not refresh the running dashboard's routing — `src/lib/github-quota/repo-notes.ts:41`
- Severity: ~ SHOULD
- Classification / scope: specification defect (in_pr_scope, docs/UX remedy)
- Trigger: the App is newly installed on an organization whose repositories the dashboard already marked "not installed". The operator runs `pan doctor`, as the Settings help text (W11) and `configuration/issue-trackers.mdx` (W12) instruct.
- Expected / observed / impact: `loadNotes()` reads `repo-notes.json` once per process. `clearAppNotInstalled` and `resetRepoInstallationCache` run only in the CLI process. Doctor's own rows are correct, which literally satisfies FR-9. The running dashboard keeps its in-memory note until it expires, up to 6 h. Until then merges, verdicts, marker approval, the Command Deck chip and Settings still act as, and show, the gh user. Nothing server-side reloads `notes`: `git grep` finds no reset outside `resetRepoNotesForTests`. Behaviour stays correct but stale, with the documented gh-user fallback.
- Fix: either reload the notes file when its mtime changes, or add a server refresh (for example a `?fresh=1` on `/api/github/identities` that doctor or Settings can call). Otherwise correct the docs and the help text to say the dashboard picks up the change within 6 h or after a restart.

### [correctness] `getBotIdentity()` still falls back to `panopticon-agent` when the slug is unknown — `src/lib/github-app.ts:700`
- Severity: ? MAY
- Classification: pre-existing behaviour
- `pan cloister status` now prints `getBotIdentity().name`, which reads `app-slug` and the resolved slug. With neither, the name is still `panopticon-agent[bot]`. AC 8 assumes a known slug, and its test injects one. This is pre-existing fallback behaviour and is advisory only.

### [correctness] `repo-notes.json` writes from `pan doctor` can land out of order — `src/lib/github-quota/repo-notes.ts:103`
- Severity: ? MAY
- Classification: unconfirmed hypothesis (benign)
- `collectGitHubIdentities({ fresh: true })` calls `clearAppNotInstalled` (background write without the note). The next 404 lookup calls `markAppNotInstalled` (background write with the note). The two renames are not ordered, so the cleared file can win. The only consequence is one extra installation lookup in the next process. The `persistSeq` suffix already prevents tmp-name collisions.

### [correctness] Refresh-token route returns 500 for an uncovered repository — `src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces.ts:1302`
- Severity: ? MAY
- Classification: spec-accepted behaviour (W5 row 17)
- `refreshWorkspaceTokenBody` now throws `GitHub App is not installed on owner/repo`, and the route surfaces it as `{ success:false, error }` with status 500. Spawn never writes bot credentials there, so nothing depends on the refresh. The PRD states this explicitly.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger (80 files)
High risk
- src/lib/github-app-auth.ts — reviewed. Auth primitives moved verbatim from github-app.ts; the token memo is now a `Map` keyed by installation id with the 5-minute reuse margin (FR-2). It imports nothing from the sibling modules (no cycle).
- src/lib/agents/spawn.ts — reviewed. The block is replaced by `configureWorkspaceGitHubIdentity` exactly as W5 #14 specifies. Errors are caught and warned, and spawn never refuses (FR-5, Decision 7). 1081 lines, at or under the cap of 1089.

Medium risk
- src/lib/github-app-installations.ts — reviewed. `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/installation` uses the JWT through `withGitHubTimeout`. Positives are cached in memory for 6 h, and in-flight lookups are shared (expiry is Infinity while pending). A 404 calls `markAppNotInstalled`. Any other status throws; `appCoversRepo` turns that into `isConfigured()` and `getRepoInstallationToken` into the home token (NFR-1). The lookup does not go through the rest meter (NFR-3).
- src/lib/github-app.ts — reviewed. `githubApi`, `githubApiAllCheckRunPages`, `githubApiAllPages` and `mergePullRequestWithApp` use `installationTokenForApiPath`. `reportCommitStatus`, `postOverdeckTestsStatus` and `refreshWorkspaceTokenBody` work per repository as W3 specifies. The `/rate_limit` path has no repository, so it uses the home installation (NFR-2). 921 lines, under the cap of 1083.
- src/lib/github-repo-identity.ts — reviewed. `resolveRepoIdentity` follows the order app → user → none. `collectGitHubIdentities` groups owners case-insensitively, sorts them, and with `fresh` clears the notes and the cache. `configureWorkspaceGitHubIdentity` calls `configureBot` only for `app` with a token.
- src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/merge-ops.ts — reviewed. Rows 1–5 match the W5 table; row 3 keeps the outer `isGitHubAppConfigured()` guard as specified.
- src/dashboard/server/routes/command-deck.ts — reviewed. Discussion sync uses `resolveGitHubIssue(issueId)` for all three `--repo` flags and for the issue number (FR-7). 1331 lines, at the cap and not raised.
- src/dashboard/server/routes/github-identities.ts, server.ts, route-scopes.ts — reviewed. The route is registered with scope `read:state` and has a no-loss-matrix row.
- src/dashboard/frontend/.../Settings/SettingsPage.tsx, settingsPageConstants.ts, sections/GitHubIdentitiesSection.tsx — reviewed. The nav item and section id match (`github-identities`). The heading markup matches TrackerKeysSection. Empty, error and data states are all rendered, and the section is read-only (FR-12).
- configuration/auto-merge.mdx, configuration/issue-trackers.mdx — reviewed (FR-13).

Low risk (reviewed)
- src/lib/cloister/{issue-closed,merge-verification,merged-pr-verification}.ts, src/lib/forge.ts, src/lib/github-pr-lookup.ts — W5 rows 6–13. In `mergeReviewArtifact`, an unparseable ref now goes to `gh pr merge` instead of throwing. That is the W5 row 12 design, and the gh path keeps `--repo`.
- src/lib/cloister/pr-review-verdict.ts, verification-check-run.ts — token per repository; a null token posts as the gh user or skips the check run (FR-6).
- src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts — `markerApproversFor` matches W13. A failed lookup returns covered=true, so only the bot's marker counts and the rule fails closed. An unparseable URL also counts as covered. Each uncovered repository logs one warning (FR-14).
- src/lib/overdeck/issue-transitions.ts — `execFileAsync` with `--repo owner/repo` on both calls. It returns early when there is no repository (FR-7).
- src/lib/github-quota/repo-notes.ts — `clearAppNotInstalled` and a shared `persistNotes` helper; the warning text is reworded.
- src/cli/commands/doctor-github-identity.ts, doctor.ts, doctor-github-quota.ts, cloister/status.ts — W8. The check only runs from the CLI: `collectDoctorChecks` has no server callers, so `fresh` never resets server caches.
- Frontend: Sidebar.tsx (1011 lines, cap 1019), sidebar/projectOwners.ts, sidebar/OwnerGroupHeader.tsx, CommandDeck/projectsData.ts, ProjectTree/{ProjectNode,ProjectIdentityChip,useGitHubIdentities}.tsx/ts, command-deck.module.css — W9/W10. Grouping appears only with two or more owners. Collapsed state is stored under `overdeck.sidebar.collapsedOwners` in try/catch. A collapsed group that holds the active project keeps the active text colour.
- packages/contracts/src/telemetry.ts, docs/TELEMETRY.md — telemetry allowlist entries (see the advisory above).
- docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, docs/REVIEW-AGENT-ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/USAGE.md, changelog.mdx — W12.
- scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt — all four new frontend tests are listed.
- tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.ts — new route row.
- All changed and new test files (~30): regex-scanned the added lines for `.skip`, `skipIf`, `.only(`, `ghs_`/`ghp_` and `readFileSync(*.ts`, with no hits. Source-introspection relies on the CI `lint` job, which passed on HEAD. Test bodies were read only where they back an AC row.
- .pan/continues/*.xbrief.json, .pan/specs xbrief — planning artifacts, not applicable.

### Dimensions
- Correctness: every call site in the W5 table is converted. Running `git grep "isGitHubAppConfigured()"` over non-test `src` gives exactly the set AC 5 allows. I also grepped every non-test caller of `getPullRequestState`, `listPullRequestsForHead`, `getCiCheckRunsState`, `getIssueState` and `mergePullRequestWithApp` outside github-app.ts (merge-ops 134/809/1006/1078/1114, issue-closed 41/101, merge-verification 180, merged-pr-verification 31, forge 166/258/272/281/430/454, github-pr-lookup 30). Each sits behind `appCoversRepo`. The sidebar blocker above is the one correctness failure. Failure modes match NFR-1: a 404 means not covered; any other error means covered, with the home token.
- Security: the only loosened trust is FR-14. On a repository confirmed uncovered by a 404, any trusted author's APPROVED marker counts. That equals the existing behaviour on a machine without the App, and the docs and a per-repository warning state it. A lookup failure keeps bot-only approval. URL parts come from projects.yaml or PR URLs, which are trusted inputs. No secrets are logged, and the credential file keeps mode 0600.
- Performance: one lookup per repository per process per 6 h, with in-flight lookups shared. `getGitHubLogin` is memoized. The identities route is cheap after warm-up, and the frontend query uses `staleTime` 60 s. Doctor's sequential `gh api` calls are CLI-only.
- Requirements/UX: see the matrix below.

### AC → evidence
| AC | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 W1 | met | `generateInstallationTokenBody(config, id)` posts to `/app/installations/${id}/access_tokens`; github-app.ts has 921 lines (≤1083); covered by github-app.test.ts |
| 2 W2 | met | 404 → `markAppNotInstalled` and a null cache entry, then `isAppMarkedNotInstalled` short-circuits; 500 → throw → `appCoversRepo` returns true; covered by github-app-installations.test.ts |
| 3 W3 | met | `githubApi` → `installationTokenForApiPath`; covered by github-app.test.ts |
| 4 W4 | met | github-repo-identity.ts; covered by github-repo-identity.test.ts |
| 5 W5 | met | sites converted; grep set as allowed; covered by forge, github-pr-lookup, issue-closed and pr-review-verdict tests |
| 6 W6 | met | issues-reopen.test.ts and command-deck-sync-discussions.test.ts |
| 7 W7 | met | github-identities.test.ts; route-scopes row `read:state`; no-loss row |
| 8 W8 | met | doctor-github-identity.test.ts and status-github-app.test.ts |
| 9 W9 | met as written; FR-10 unmet | the AC 9 cases pass (Sidebar.ownerGroups.test.tsx, projectOwners.test.ts). FR-10's "fewer than two owners renders as today" fails with a stored "Other" collapse (blocking finding) |
| 10 W10 | met | ProjectIdentityChip.test.tsx |
| 11 W11 | met | GitHubIdentitiesSection.test.tsx |
| 12 W13 | met | pr-facts-verdict-marker.test.ts |
| 13 W12 | met | the heading "GitHub organizations and identities" is present; changelog entries are present; the CI `lint` job passed on HEAD |

Non-goals: none violated in substance. The contracts telemetry entry is forced by the route-scopes test. There is no second App, no per-repository id stored on disk, and no PAT-path changes. NFR-2 functions are unchanged. The allowlist is not raised and no Effect wrappers are added. The contracts note is above.

## Verification
- CI on PR head 8d1ca5fa (`gh pr checks feature/pan-5153`): every job passed — test, test-shard 1/4–4/4, test-e2e, lint, lint-group core/effect/state/skills, build (22), clean install + server smoke, integrations, prompt-trailer gate, overdeck/test. Mintlify was skipped. CodeRabbit was rate-limited (advisory).
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics` run once on HEAD: "Effect diagnostics guard passed (227 known findings; none new)".
- Focused backend vitest (17 files: github-app-installations, github-app, github-repo-identity, doctor-github-identity, status-github-app, verification-check-run, pr-facts-verdict-marker, pr-review-verdict, forge, github-pr-lookup, command-deck-sync-discussions, issues-reopen, github-identities, route-scopes, no-loss-matrix, merge-ops-clean-direct, agent-state-role): 216/216 passed.
- Focused frontend vitest (5 files: ProjectIdentityChip, GitHubIdentitiesSection, Sidebar.ownerGroups, projectOwners, ProjectNode): 28/28 passed.
- Line caps checked with `wc -l`. `scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt` is unchanged.
- Not run: the full test suite (CI owns it) and any live feature-stack check (not needed for this change).

Fix every blocking review finding, commit the fixes, then re-request review with:

`pan review request PAN-5153 -m "Fixed review issues"`
